issue.title: sase: one colliding artifact-link event pair blocks every future link write
issue.description: sase's artifact-link event store validates the whole store on every read and write, so one historical operation_id with two different payloads blocks every future link write in the project. It should quarantine the bad pair and keep accepting unrelated appends.

task_type_fields.impact:
Impact: for a month, no typed artifact link could be written. That included `/sase_new_task` related links and `sase plan propose` with a `links:` inlet (see the sibling plan-propose bug). Relations were kept as free text on at least 14 bead pairs and later backfilled by hand. The publication outbox also grew to 12,931 lines while publication refused.

Desired remediation: quarantine a conflicting operation-id pair, keep it surfaced by `sase artifact doctor`, and keep accepting unrelated appends. It should also be clear which payload is canonical, for example the earliest durable object, with the replay quarantined. Add regression coverage that a store holding one colliding pair still accepts a fresh link add.
task_type_fields.location: sase artifact-link event store validation (load_artifact_rows / assert_healthy, operation_id reuse check)
task_type_fields.repro:
Repo: sase (external project; open it with `/sase_repo` before reading or editing). Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-5k.4 (note #1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) during epic bob-cli-5k; triaged by bob-cli-5k.land.

Repro (historical; recorded on bob-cli-21):
- From about 2026-09-07 to 2026-10-07, every `sase artifact link add` in project gh_bobs-org__bob-cli failed with `artifact-link event store is invalid: validation: operation_id de29d2e25c1cfb4381f223c44d576f8c was reused for different artifact link events`.
- One historical operation id had two different canonical payloads, in `link-events/v1/6e/6efae635…json` and `link-events/v1/51/513bdb20…json`. The 51/513bdb object was a later c963f9c replay.
- Whole-store validation (`load_artifact_rows` -> `assert_healthy`) treats any such pair as fatal for every reader and writer. Six independent +1 reproductions are on bob-cli-21.
- bob-cli-5k.4 repaired the data by hand: it deleted the two replay objects and pruned 6 outbox lines. No sase code changed, so the next colliding pair will block the store again.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-5k.4 hand-repaired a month-long artifact-link outage (bob-cli-21) without changing sase, so the next colliding operation-id pair will again block every link write; the epic plan asked the lander to file this hardening.

payload.description: the month-long outage and hand repair this hardening would prevent
sibling sase hardening from the same outage
